title: Can this streaming stage keep up?
description: Use a measured per-worker rate to compare arrivals with current capacity, the configured worker ceiling, and usable key parallelism. The model exposes its arithmetic and does not predict Dataflow autoscaling latency.

scenarios.label: Measured steady load
scenarios.detail: The active pool has capacity headroom and key distribution is not the binding constraint.

scenarios.label: Arrival spike
scenarios.detail: Current workers fall behind, but the configured ceiling has enough measured capacity to recover.

scenarios.label: Hot-key bottleneck
scenarios.detail: Only a few keys expose useful parallel work, so adding workers cannot raise this stage above that limit.
